no_api_findings.finding: The documented standard library has no MPEG Layer III audio or ID3v2 tag parser. std::fs::read and std::io::Read return bytes without interpreting frames, audio samples, or metadata tags. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid control.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library; external crates and native system libraries are separate.
